statement: Marvell's data center segment revenue reached $2.171 billion in Q2 FY2027, up 46% year over year and 79% of total company revenue of $2.739 billion.
why: Data center is now nearly four-fifths of Marvell's revenue and is growing faster than the company overall, which reads as continued AI infrastructure buying by its customers.

impact.mechanism: Growth in custom silicon and data-center connectivity revenue tracks the same AI build-out that drives merchant GPU and fabric demand.
